name: Archie initiative checks (one Telegram message per due initiative, or silence)

knobs.note: BH-4062: 0 stops the tick before any request. Read by bin/archie.sh as ${ARCHIE_ENABLED:-1}; any value other than 0 or 1 is one warn line in logs/archie.log and the default.

BH-4062: initiatives checked per tick, at most one model call each. More due than this: the rest stay due for the next tick (logged deferred). Read by bin/archie.sh as ${ARCHIE_MAX_PER_TICK:-3}; outside 1..20 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4062: hours between checks for an `Archie, track` message that names no `every:`. Read by bin/archie.sh intercept (archie_parse_track in bin/lib/archie.sh) as ${ARCHIE_DEFAULT_CADENCE_H:-24}; outside 1..2160 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4062: billed model failures on one check before the slot is closed (advanced to the next cadence) with ONE ALERTS line. BH-4609: this covers ordinary billed failures; a slot whose last failure was a budget stop uses ARCHIE_RETRY_MAX instead. Read by bin/archie.sh as ${ARCHIE_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-2}; outside 1..10 is one warn line and the default.
BH-4062: the recommendation line of a beat is cut to this many characters. Read by bin/archie.sh as ${ARCHIE_TEXT_MAX_CHARS:-600}; outside 100..2000 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4062: USD cap on each check's model call (AGENT_CALL_BUDGET_USD_ARCHIE). 0 makes no model call: escalating rows stay due. BH-4609: the default is 0.60 because an Opus first turn through the claude CLI costs more than $0.10 (Archie's I2 hit a BUDGET STOP on 2026-10-05 and the hub settings row lane.archie.archie_llm_max_usd=0.60 fixed it there). Read by bin/archie.sh as ${ARCHIE_LLM_MAX_USD:-0.60}; not a number is one warn line and the default.

BH-4609: the most billed attempts one check slot may make when its last failure was a budget stop (the call hit ARCHIE_LLM_MAX_USD). At the cap the slot closes to the next cadence with ONE ALERTS line. 1 means no retry. Worst case per slot is this times ARCHIE_LLM_MAX_USD. Read by bin/archie.sh as ${ARCHIE_RETRY_MAX:-6}; outside 1..48 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4609: minutes between a budget stop and the next attempt on that check slot. The slot stays open (not advanced) and the tick skips it, before any metric read or spend, until the retry_after stored in the model_failed event's body. Read by bin/archie.sh as ${ARCHIE_RETRY_BACKOFF_MIN:-60}; outside 15..1440 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4609: hours until an initiative whose metric was unreadable is checked again, capped at its own cadence (a 6h initiative still re-checks every 6h). Each re-check is its own slot, so `unreadable` is recorded once per re-check. Once the metric reads, the next cadence counts from that check, so a weekly grid moves. Read by bin/archie.sh as ${ARCHIE_UNREADABLE_RECHECK_H:-24}; outside 1..168 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4067: agreements in a row on one class of call before Archie's reply offers to handle that class himself, and the least streak `Archie delegate <class>` accepts. Settings row lane.archie.archie_delegate_after (seeded 5 in worker/jobs/schema.sql). Read by bin/archie.sh intercept as ${ARCHIE_DELEGATE_AFTER:-5}; outside 2..50 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4063: Archie beats sent per UTC day (ledger archie_beatday <day>); past it each beat is held (ledger archie_digest, queued) and the first allowed tick sends all held ones as ONE digest beat, which counts as one. 0 holds every beat and sends one digest a day. Read by bin/lib/archie-wake.sh as ${ARCHIE_BEAT_CAP_DAY:-5}; outside 0..100 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4063: start of Archie's quiet hours, UTC hour. Beats in from <= hour < to (wrapping midnight when from > to) are held for the digest. Equal from and to (the default 0/0) means no quiet hours. Read by bin/lib/archie-wake.sh as ${ARCHIE_QUIET_FROM_H:-0}; outside 0..23 is one warn line and the default.
BH-4063: end of Archie's quiet hours, UTC hour (exclusive); see ARCHIE_QUIET_FROM_H. Read by bin/lib/archie-wake.sh as ${ARCHIE_QUIET_TO_H:-0}; outside 0..23 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4063: which logs/ALERTS.log lines wake Archie. 1: only lines naming an initiative's linked ticket (#N or BH-N). 2: every other line too, on the factory-watch initiative. 0: none. DAILY SPEND CAP lines always wake factory-watch. Read by bin/lib/archie-wake.sh as ${ARCHIE_WAKE_ALERT_SCOPE:-1}; outside 0..2 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4779: the Telegram chat every Archie message goes to (checks, follow-up-woken checks, the held digest, and bin/daily-digest.sh's daily report), shape <chat_id> or <chat_id>/<thread_id> (the thread only on a -100... supergroup). Blank means the operator's DM: the chat lib.lane-alert.lane_alert_dm_chat resolves to. A malformed value is one warn line in logs/archie.log and that default. Read by bin/archie-tg-send.sh through lane_knob.

knobs.default: nothing (here )?for you|nothing (you need |that needs you )?to (do|decide|approve|act on)|nothing (is )?(needed|required) (from|of) you|no action (is )?(needed|required)|(don.{0,3}t|do not) need to do anything|no need for you to
knobs.note: BH-4779: case-insensitive ERE. A check answer whose sentence matches it, and matches neither ARCHIE_ASK_RE nor ARCHIE_NEWS_RE, says nothing is needed from the operator: the slot closes `empty`, no decision row, no message. Read by bin/lib/archie.sh (archie_no_action) as ${ARCHIE_NO_ACTION_RE:-<this default>}.

knobs.default: \?|\b(can|could|would|will) you\b|\bplease\b|\bshould (i|we)\b|\bwant me to\b|\byour call\b|\bup to you\b|\blet me know\b|\b(approve|drop|change) i[0-9]+|\bneeds? your (ok|okay|approval|decision|call|input|eyes)\b|\bdecide (whether|if|which|between|on)\b
knobs.note: BH-4779: case-insensitive ERE for an ask in a check answer (a question mark, can/could you, please, should I, approve I<n>, your call...). An answer that matches it is always sent, whatever ARCHIE_NO_ACTION_RE says. Read by bin/lib/archie.sh (archie_no_action) as ${ARCHIE_ASK_RE:-<this default>}.

BH-4779: case-insensitive ERE for news in a check answer (something went red, failed, tripped, was paused, reverted, re-queued or blocked). An answer that matches it is always sent, even when it also says nothing is needed from the operator: the guard silences only an answer whose sole content is that nothing is needed. Read by bin/lib/archie.sh (archie_no_action) as ${ARCHIE_NEWS_RE:-<this default>}.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.
Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend, never from the box's own logs/cost.csv.

Not a knob: bin/orchestrate.sh's archie intercept block sets it per message to the chat command id, and bin/archie.sh intercept reads it as ${ARCHIE_CMD_ID:-} to key a reply (reply:<id>:<command id>; absent = a hash of the text). NOT settable from the control plane.

Read by bin/archie.sh intercept as ${JOBS_BODY:-}: the jobs worker's last response body, set by _jobs_req (bin/lib/jobs/req.sh), used to name the field a 400 refused. Plumbing, not a knob. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/archie.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: a file bin/archie.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam gate: bin/archie.sh honours ARCHIE_NOW and sources ARCHIE_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
